verdict.rationale: Toolchain and environment management is a fair question for a JavaScript package manager, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows npm switching tool versions or loading environment variables automatically when you enter a project directory. The NPM_CONFIG_ environment-variable mechanism only sets npm's own config and is an adjacent feature, not directory-triggered activation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the right tool versions and environment variables activate automatically when I enter a project directory
